questions.question: For the statistically valid regional survey, should respondent recruitment, incentives, translation, accessibility accommodations, weighting, and survey-platform costs all be included within the $215,000 base-scope ceiling?
questions.why_it_matters: The survey methodology and representativeness are explicit response requirements and can consume a material share of the budget.

questions.question: What travel-demand-model outputs, staff support, documentation, and license access will IMPO make available before the updated ITDM modules become available in early 2028?
questions.why_it_matters: The RFP requires a two-pass project scoring and fiscal-constraint process while model availability changes during performance.

questions.question: Does the stated $215,000 not-to-exceed budget include all optional services, or should optional/additive services be priced outside the base-scope ceiling?
questions.why_it_matters: The RFP asks respondents to distinguish base and optional services but does not unambiguously state how the ceiling applies to options.

questions.question: Will IMPO accept a lead consultant that discloses specialist subcontractors for survey methodology, public engagement, accessibility, GIS, and travel-model analysis, provided all roles and commitments are fully identified in Form B and the proposal?
questions.why_it_matters: The vendor instructions prohibit undisclosed delegation and require the respondent to be capable of supplying the full work.

questions.question: Please confirm whether the insurance clause with specified general, auto, umbrella, workers compensation, and employer liability limits will apply, or whether the professional-services no-insurance alternative in the sample contract may be selected during negotiation.
questions.why_it_matters: The sample contract contains both a detailed insurance clause and an alternative no-insurance clause.

questions.question: Are there any required disadvantaged-business, minority-, women-, veteran-, or local-business participation goals or reporting obligations for this federally funded procurement beyond the included Title VI assurances?
questions.why_it_matters: Federal participation and partnering strategy may affect team composition, forms, and cost.

questions.question: May the separate quote identify assumptions and task-level contingencies, and will the quote be evaluated for reasonableness even though the published scoring criteria allocate all 100 points to approach, team, and past experience?
questions.why_it_matters: The response requires task-level rates and hours, while the scoring table does not assign pricing points.

questions.question: What minimum in-person presence is expected for committee meetings, public engagement, workshops, and milestone presentations?
questions.why_it_matters: Travel and local facilitation assumptions materially affect staffing, partner selection, and price.
